title: Event-driven backtest state and accounting

objectives.text: Trace a complete deterministic one-asset long-only next-open target backtest with explicit fill/mark/signal ordering and unfilled/terminal state.
Reconcile signed executions,cash,positions and marked equity under bounded integer-cents assumptions,without treating marks or pending orders as realized trades.

blocks.markdown: A backtest is a state transition system,not a vector of attractive returns. State here is integer cash cents,integer shares0..10and a pending TARGETposition created after each close. Each synthetic bar contains(time,opening reference cents,closing mark cents,executable capacity at open). Capacity is a supplied ex-ante scenario at the opening attempt,NOTfull-day volume magically known at the open. This educational engine has no real exchange,account,margin,borrowing,dividends,splits,funding or short sales.

At each bar:attempt the PREVIOUSclose target at the current open,constrain quantity by scenario capacity/cash/holdings,expire any remainder,mark position at this bar's close,then accept a NEWclose target. A close-derived target cannot execute at the same close in this own next-open model. Targets in this example are externally supplied hypothetical decisions;the engine does not prove they were generated from historical-only inputs. Point-in-time signal construction remains a separate requirement.

blocks.title: Signal price is not execution price

steps.text: Start1000cents,no shares. At bar0close100create target2. No earlier order exists,so no fill and equity1000.
At bar1open110buy2for220,leaving cash780and position2. Close mark115gives equity780+2*115=1010. At that close create target0.
At bar2open120sell2for240,cash1020,position0,equity1020. New final target0is still pending with no next bar. The20cent PnLis from actual buy110/sell120,not the earlier signal close100.

blocks.caption: Expected rows:(0,0,None,1000,0,100,1000,2,0);(1,2,110,780,2,115,1010,0,0);(2,-2,120,1020,0,120,1020,0,0);pending target0;flat strategy1000;invalid bar domain or order. Full source includes optional cost arguments taught next,all zero here. Max128bars/10shares,strict integer inputs,no bool,contiguous own times. Entire input validated before returns. Last pending target is metadata,not a final execution or forced liquidation.

blocks.markdown: At a buy quantityq,execution pricexand per-unit feef:cash_new=cash_old-q*(x+f),position_new=position_old+q. At a sell:cash_new=cash_old+q*(x-f),position_new=position_old-q. At a closing markm,equity=cash+position*m. This single-asset integer-cents model has exact arithmetic,not float reconciliation noise. The price/units policy must be changed explicitly for fractional shares,FX,multipliers,fees with rounding or corporate actions.

A target is a desired position,not an instruction to buy that many additional shares each time. Delta=pending_target-current_position;capacity/cash can yield partial or zero fill. An unfilled remainder expires at the one opening attempt;the next close can independently create the same target again. Marked equity is an accounting valuation,not executable liquidation proceeds. If the final position is nonzero,report it and the pending target;do not silently force a last-close sale or label all PnLrealized.

After every row require nonnegative cash,position0..10,equity identity,abs(execution)<=capacity,and cash/position change exactly matching price/fee. First row has no fill;no earlier ledger prefix should change if a later bar/target is perturbed,except that whole-input invalidity can fail the run. Determinism shows reproducibility of the stated model,not market realism or strategy validity. Bars ordered/complete in this own integer clock do not implement sessions,halts or auctions.

Backtrader's documented bar model fills market orders at the next bar open and says its default execution logic ignores volume. QuantConnectuses different asset/order/data-specific fill rules,including best-effort bid/ask and documented complete-fill assumptions. These are source-specific model choices,not a universal exchange law. Our capacity-limited one-attempt target model is its own design and must not be labeled as either library's implementation.

Independent transfer:use one bar only and confirm no fill;change the first target and show it cannot change first-bar equity. Give bar1capacity1with target2and inspect one filled/one expired share;make cash insufficient and confirm it cannot go negative. End with a nonzero holding and reconcile marked equity separately from hypothetical liquidation. Build an independent cashflow ledger rather than copying the same transition formulas into the sole oracle.

Sources:[Backtraderbar-order execution](https://www.backtrader.com/docu/order-creation-execution/order-creation-execution/),[QuantConnectfill concepts](https://www.quantconnect.com/docs/v2/writing-algorithms/reality-modeling/trade-fills/key-concepts),[Equityfill source-specific rules](https://www.quantconnect.com/docs/v2/writing-algorithms/reality-modeling/trade-fills/supported-models/equity-model). Own bar/target schema and accounting example are synthetic. No external package required.

summary: Execute previous close targets only at the next opening attempt,then mark and create new targets. Cash/position/equity must reconcile at each step. Pending targets and marked holdings are not realized fills;deterministic source tests do not certify market realism.
